Direction for questions :

Pool A and Pool B are the two pools into which the 14 teams competing in the Cricket World Cup were divided. There were seven teams in each pool. Each team plays one match against every other team in the same pool. The team receives two points for a victory and no points for a defeat. In case of a draw, the winning point i.e. '2' will be divided equally between the two teams.
Following the completion of the pool stages, the top three teams, determined by point (total), moved on to the super six round. Each of the three teams from Pool A plays against all selected teams from Pool B during the super six-round, where all teams start with zero points. Points are given out just like in the pool phase. Following the games, the top four teams in terms of points move on to the semi-finals. In the semi-final stage No. 1 plays against No.4 and No. 2 plays against No. 3. Winner of both the semi-final matches will be headed against each other in the final to grab the championship.

What is the maximum point that can be scored by a team in pool stage?
